nodes.label: Single Source of Truth Principle
nodes.rationale: Quant-Math owns ALL engines (backtesting, Monte Carlo, risk, expectation, execution, data); AQDE is a consumer via thin wrappers, never reimplementing core logic.

nodes.label: 100% Real Bybit Data Policy
nodes.rationale: Synthetic-data route unreachable from CLI (hardcoded force_real_data=True); Monte Carlo only resamples real trade PnLs.

nodes.label: Data-Starvation Safe Collecting Mode
nodes.rationale: Below minimum sample thresholds every learner stays in 'collecting' mode instead of acting on insufficient evidence.

nodes.label: P1 Ranking Fallback (next-best candidate)
nodes.rationale: If the best-ranked candidate already has an open position, the next-best enters (per-candidate gate); eliminates idling caused by the position guard.

nodes.label: PA Live Expectancy (Bayesian Shrinkage, [exp-refresh])
nodes.rationale: After each closure the record's expectancy is re-blended toward realized results: est = (n*own + 3*family)/(n+3); exp = w*gen + (1-w)*est with w = n/(n+5); persisted in PG+JSONL; logged as [exp-refresh].

nodes.label: PB Auto-Graduation of LEARN_MODE
nodes.rationale: When the last N closures average positive, LEARN_MODE is disabled and the gate restored; persisted in runtime/state/graduation.json; controlled by QUANTMATH_AUTO_GRADUATE / QUANTMATH_GRAD_WINDOW.

nodes.label: Expectancy Gate Invariant (Sacred Gate)
nodes.rationale: No ML layer may open trades; entry requires each hypothesis's own real backtested expectancy > 0; temporary bypass only via LEARN_MODE (paper-only).

nodes.label: SL Overshoot Structural Slippage
nodes.rationale: TP/SL checked once per cycle against real close price; price can overshoot the level between checks (SL 2.5% -> observed closures 2.52-2.81%). Documented as structural slippage by design, not a bug; possible future mitigation: intrabar high/low evaluation.

nodes.label: Advisory-Only Learning Guarantee
nodes.rationale: All generation-side learning biases WHAT gets generated, never WHETHER a trade happens; PA changes ranking, PB only flips the gate back on.
